answer: Per-identity leak tracing: 1 in 20 challenges hides a private decoy keyed to that agent alone, such as a short cipher string or a made-up detail like a walnut ledger opening at block 4471, as distinctive as a veined marble tile. Honest agents never see each other's decoys, so if one identity's decoy shows up in another's answer twice, both are merged and lose that epoch's pay. A farm reusing one pipeline across N fakes leaks almost surely, so each fake needs its own isolated context, cost growing linearly. Weakness: an operator who strips odd details avoids it.
